en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a river scene with several rowboats and buildings along the water. The background is dominated by a tall, Gothic-style church with a prominent clock tower. Visible text on the front reads 'Motiv från Selångersån.' The back contains handwritten correspondence in Swedish, a green Swedish postage stamp, and mailbox marks with 'SUNDSVALL' and the date '31.7.19'.
